extraction.basis: DC/trend plus real sin/cos h1..10 times local envelope polynomial of stated degree; normalized centered time, Hann weights; QR/SVD, no normal equations. Evaluate every center at the same integer source-frame time, including even-length nested supports. Fixed prior f0 only; no per-note frequency fit.
extraction.conditioning: Full column rank and design condition number<=1e8; otherwise affected cell is unknown, not a pseudoinverse precision claim.
extraction.complex_definition: Z_h=(c_cos_h - i*c_sin_h)/2 at the common center frame.
extraction.quantization_bound: All old and new controls are converted to deterministic nearest PCM16 identically to v1, including reused native float WAVs. q_h=(1/(2*32768))*sum_n abs(p_h[n]), p_h=(P_cos_h-i*P_sin_h)/2. Triangle bound for deterministic nearest rounding, NOT a white-noise standard error. Require old reconstructed quantized waveform hashes match v1 exactly before extraction.
extraction.radius: r_h=2*max(abs(Zcentral-Zouter_comparison),abs(Zcentral-Znested_comparison))+qcentral_h+quiet_h, where quiet_h=abs(Zquiet_h)+qquiet_h from unchanged entry-.15..-.05 reference.
extraction.radius_limit: The2x disagreement factor is a prospective empirical approximation-bias allowance, not a proved arbitrary-envelope/filter bound. The fixed quiet-reference allowance is not a bound on later nonstationary interference. Must pass all fixed clean synthetic coverage; no post-result multiplier changes.
extraction.cell_diagnostics: Preserve original peak<.98, finite and weighted residual<=.1 / H1 power fraction>=.005 diagnostics; failures produce explicit unknown intervals. All H1..6 complex disks are kept; weak harmonics are not exact constraints or silently deleted.
extraction.quiet_definition: Fit the same central degree2 harmonic basis over unchanged entry-.15..-.05 reference. Its |Zquiet|+qquiet term is a fixed reference allowance. It is not a proved bound on later contamination, noise power or white residuals.

set_propagation.amplitude: Complex disk maps to [max(absZ-r,0),absZ+r]. Denominator interval containing0 yields unbounded ratios. Anchor H1 containing0 makes entire note unknown; never floor, replace anchor or discard that branch.
set_propagation.phase: If disk includes0 phase is full circle; else argZ +/- asin(r/absZ). Circular Minkowski sums with h-times anchor/H1 intervals retain wraparound/full-circle sets.
set_propagation.comparison: Use all15 fixed pairwise temporal amplitude double ratios among harmonics1..6, plus each pair phase invariant j*arg(Z_h(t)/Z_h(anchor))-h*arg(Z_j(t)/Z_j(anchor)), with full PM coefficient/canonical delta/conjugate branches. Same first-body anchor, no new harmonic bins or windows. Interval intersections per pair, not independent statistical tests. Non-H1 pairs retain constraints when a MODEL H1 cell spans a null; all unconstrained/null branches remain, and A can stay unbounded even if beta is constrained.
set_propagation.model_domain: beta .001..8; canonical delta0..pi/2; all signs/compatible branches. Bounds remain conditional finite-domain sets, not global identification or confidence intervals. No exponential/monotonicity/rate-family prior.
set_propagation.grid_proposal: 2401 logarithmic beta nodes in[.001,8] and33 canonical delta nodes in[0,pi/2]. Each represents its geometric beta half-cell and midpoint delta half-cell, clipped at stated domain endpoints. Outward bounds use full cell edges; any compatible endpoint-touching cell makes precision unknown. Nested4801x65 repeats fixed controls. Never choose a better source grid.
set_propagation.A_beta_slopes: Same34 latent epochs; conservative OLS extrema for each original17-point body/late interval across ALL compatible nuisance and per-time branches. Report A/beta separately, with broad/unbounded and endpoint-touching status. Body A need not be precise.

grid_enclosure.Bessel: Let e=max(abs(betaLow-betaCenter),abs(betaHigh-betaCenter)); enclose each needed integer J_n by J_n(center) +/- [abs(Jprime_n(center))*e+.5*e^2]. Jprime=(J_(n-1)-J_(n+1))/2. This is a Taylor enclosure because |Jdoubleprime_n|<=1 for real arguments/integer order (recurrence and |J_n|<=1).
grid_enclosure.magnitude_squared: With m=J_(h-1),p=J_(h+1),s=(-1)^(h+1), interval-evaluate absB_h^2=(m^2+p^2-2*s*m*p*cos(2delta))/4 and clip lower at0. All square/product dependencies conservatively enclosed; optional intersection with rectangle-magnitude enclosure is valid only if both individually contain the cell.
grid_enclosure.phase: Interval-evaluate realB=sin(delta)*(m+s*p)/2 and imagB=-cos(delta)*(m-s*p)/2; a rectangle containing the origin gives full circle, otherwise the circular hull of all corner directions. Retain both conjugate signs. Numerical roundoff margin is prospective64*float64eps*max(1,abs intermediates) per interval operation; no measured dB floor.
grid_enclosure.ratios: Define Q_h=abs(Z_h)^2 and M_h=abs(B_h)^2. Compare squared amplitude double-ratio sets [Q_h(t)*Q_j(anchor)]/[Q_j(t)*Q_h(anchor)] and the corresponding M interval expression for every pair1<=j<h<=6; 10log10 of a Q ratio is an amplitude-ratio dB value. Zero numerator permits lower0; zero denominator permits upperinfinity;0/0 permits fullnonnegative set. A pair lacking information imposes no constraint. Circular phase sets as declared. Shared-variable dependencies may only be widened. Actual observed anchorH1 disk containing0 still makes note unknown and is never replaced.
grid_enclosure.conditional_scope: Enclosures cover all continuous points in represented finite cells if implementation passes independent scalar/analytic tests. They do not cover beta outside[.001,8] or changing relative phase/capture transfer. Correlations may be discarded only to widen sets, never tighten.
grid_enclosure.floating_limit: 64epsilon padding/outward nextafter operations are a numerical safety convention, NOT a formally certified special-function error bound. Test fixed grid/boundary/null cells against independent high-precision Bessel evaluation and wrapped phases before any source inference. Preserve any enclosure failure as a failed qualification.

set_propagation.incompatibility: Distinguish no-information from incompatibility: a missing/zero-containing measurement yields a broad/unknown result; an empty compatible set on a well-observed clean case is a qualification failure and may not be relabeled unknown.
set_propagation.survival_limit: Surviving grid cells mean NOT EXCLUDED by the conservative interval checks, not proof of an exact common-delta trajectory. Discarded dependencies can admit incompatible point assignments; use outer bounds only, never a best-fit or statistical weight.
set_propagation.endpoint_policy: If ANY surviving anchor cell or candidate epoch cell touches beta domain endpoint.001 or8, the full note has an endpoint warning; all A/beta precision flags are false. Report its finite/extended sets anyway. This deliberately conservative global policy is not weakened by choosing an interval after results.

controls.signal: Entry.3s,2s44100Hz; tau=max(t-.3,0)*(1+ppm*1e-6); theta=2*pi*(f*tau+initial_phase_cycles); attenuation polynomials a1*tau+a2*tau^2+a3*tau^3 dB. A=A0*10^(-attenA/20), beta=beta0*10^(-attenBeta/20); y=A*sin(theta+delta+beta*sin(theta)), zero beforeentry; PCM16 nearest/no dither. Truth slopes are exact OLS of the latent dB sequences at actual rounded centers, not polynomial linear coefficients.

prospective_null_confusion_cases.expected: Relative beta slope0 must be covered; anchor beta remains nonunique (at leastfactor4 or endpoint reach); A may qualify.

controls.processors: nearby_tone adds0.3*A(t)*sin(2pi*((f+.7)*tau+declaredphase)) to the base waveform; independent_H2 adds.25*A*sin(2theta+.5*sin(2pi*3*tau)); delayedcopy adds.6*y(t-.025); chorus=.5*y(t)+.5*y(t-[.020+.004*sin(2pi*.8*tau)]) using linear sample interpolation and zero out-of-range; dynamic_gain multiplies10^(12*tau/20). Processing precedes deterministic PCM16 nearest rounding. NativeWAVs reused, no rerender.
controls.reused_waveform_policy: Read the existing10 native float WAVs and render metadata; verify file hashes, then quantize identically to v1. Reconstruct analytic oldcases using their original exact equations/order. Require ALL56 quantized_float64 waveform hashes equal the original frozen run before any v2 extraction; no native rebuild or production-source dependence is introduced.

prospective_qualification.coverage: Every A/beta body/late interval for ALL45 reused recovery and28 prospective clean cases must contain unexpanded generating truth OR be explicitly unknown/unbounded and noninformative because information is missing. Empty compatible sets on well-observed clean data FAIL. Every analytic case additionally requires retention of the represented true anchor-beta/delta/sign cell and containment of true per-epoch relative A/beta whenever informative. No additive error allowance. Native cases retain slope-truth checks; their unrecorded exact relative phase is not invented.
prospective_qualification.nonvacuity: ALL8 new-informative cases must produce finite late A width<=3dB/s and beta width<=4dB/s, contain truth unexpanded, exclude zero decay, and avoid beta endpoint hits. Body A is reported even when broad; no forced body-A precision.
prospective_qualification.source_status: After whole-method gates pass, report all42 original source intervals as conditional sets. A and beta precision flags are independent: width<=3dB/s A,<=4dB/s beta, finite, no accepted model-domain endpoint touch for that observable, compatible model and no bad anchor. Broad/unbounded A is not silently dropped and does not disqualify a separately informative beta interval. No claim of dry effects, clean capture, known noteoff or intrinsic operator rate.
prospective_qualification.false_claims: No unique beta on sine, no anchor replacement for nulls, no invented intrinsic-A on dynamic gain pair. Processed confound admissions are explicitly tabulated and prevent any claim that model compatibility proves a dry or unprocessed original recording.
prospective_qualification.grid: Nested4801x65 checks ALL8 new-informative fixtures plus oldanalytic00/11/24 andconstant-beta. For informative controls, both interval endpoints change<=.5dB/s A,<=1dB/s beta; truth must remain covered on bothgrids and endpoint-status agree. Constantbeta remains nonunique. Failure stops source inference, with no posthoc grid/radius rescue.
prospective_qualification.null_gate: Pure sine: no beta-slope precision. Constant beta: include0 slope and retain absolute anchor beta spanningfactor4 or endpoint-reach. Anchor null: no reanchoring, unknown if H1 disk contains0. All broad/unknown outcomes explicitly retained; none treated as useful information.
prospective_qualification.confound_gate: Every old/new processing-confound admission and resulting slope bias must be tabulated. There is no unjustified promise to detect every coherent or observationally equivalent processor. Any admitted interference prohibits a claim that these empirical disks bound arbitrary contamination; all source results remain conditional on the PM/static-transfer class. The dynamic-gain pair must report the captured-A interpretation and never an intrinsic hardware-A claim.
prospective_qualification.enclosure_test: Before source inference, verify interval primitives/phase wrap/zero denominators and grid Taylor cells at deterministic nested-grid boundaries, near each low-order Bessel null within[.001,8], and a fixed seeded stratified set against80decimal mpmath Bessel values. Minimum1000cells x7samplepoints x6harmonics. Any miss or non-outward primitive FAILS. This is numerical validation, not a global formal proof.

policy: No Source/native/preset/noise changes, media downloads, physicalrate fitting, source-window changes or forecast changes. All new numerical controls wait for independently reviewed final design, frozen case/rule document and exact implementation binding before run. Any frozen failure stops source inference; preserve v1 unchanged.
source_interpretation: All42 source intervals reported if method qualifies; corresponding A or beta numeric rate only when finite, within width3/4dB/s respectively, no endpoint reach and model-compatible. If body A is broad but beta is informative, report this separately. No comparison to candidate physicalrate families unless that observable has qualified conditional precision; report overlapping predictions as unresolved. Never infer dry hardware/capture or known MIDI gate from this sample.

numerical_conventions.dtype: float64;64machine-epsilon padding at interval operation boundaries and outward nextafter. No claim of formally certified special-function implementation.
numerical_conventions.unknown_vs_failure: Metadata-ineligible/missing support, bad/rank-deficient fit, clipped/nonfinite observation, observedH1 disk containing0 => explicit unobserved/unknown. A well-observed clean case with zero surviving profiles => incompatible and method failure. Broad surviving sets can be unbounded/noninformative but never hidden.
numerical_conventions.reuse_order: Old analytic signals call the original hash-bound analytic_signal() function unchanged; old native float WAV read/channel mean and deterministic PCM16 conversion identical to original loop. Verify all56 old quantized float64 waveform hashes before v2 extraction.
numerical_conventions.processing_order: Generate new full dynamic waveform; apply fixed declared processor; deterministic PCM16 nearest/clipping exactly as v1. No dithering/additive noise. Clipping in clean cases invalidates their useful precision and is recorded, not normalized away.
numerical_conventions.truth: Evaluate analytic latent logA/logbeta at actual integerframe centers and use exact same OLS functional. Dynamic-gain truth is capturedA including gain. Native nominal slopes are originalfrozen truths, no new engine fit.
numerical_conventions.control_result_order: Run all56 old and37 prospective cases, all12nested-grid checks and mathematical enclosure tests; retain failures. Only then whole-method gate; no early-abort discarding adverse controls, except a fatal binding/output error.
numerical_conventions.code_binding: Before any numerical test/extraction, produce a fresh ignored execution binding containing this protocol hash, exact v2 and importedv1 tool hashes, originalresult hash, all10nativeWAV+render metadata hashes, dependencies/platform and no source-read status. New run refuses changed binding, reused output or output outsideignored build.
